servinfo.title: Steering Gear Case Assembly Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions before starting the procedure below can result in damage to the contact coil of the air bag system.
Before starting the procedure below, set the front wheels in straight ahead position and then lock the steering wheel by changing ignition mode to “OFF”.

s1.ptxt: Remove front suspension frame with steering gear case assembly.
Remove steering gear packing (1) after detaching its claws (3) from gear case.
Remove steering gear case bolts (4), and then remove steering gear case assembly (2) from front suspension frame.
Mount steering gear case assembly (1) to front suspension frame.
Install new steering gear case bolts (2) to specified torques.

attention4.ptxt: The steering gear case bolts are pre-coated with friction stabilizer. If these bolts are reused, they may work loose.
Never reuse the steering gear case bolts.

s1.ptxt: Aligning protrusion on new steering gear packing (1) with notch on steering gear case assembly at specified position (2), install steering gear packing to steering gear case.

attention4.ptxt: If steering gear case packing is reused, it will lose the sealing performance and water may enter the steering gear case.
Do not reuse the steering gear case packing.

s1.ptxt: Check that steering gear packing is fastened securely with its claws (3).
Install front suspension frame with steering gear case assembly.
Check and adjust front wheel alignment.
